description: FICPOA crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C105 H69 La1 N5 O18 Yb2 1+,10(C5 H5 N1),N1 O3 1-. From the CIF bond table, La1 (La) has 8 O neighbors; Yb1 (Yb) has 7 O neighbors; Yb2 (Yb) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.942-3.945 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 101.42-106.21°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Yb2La(LA)2(LB)2(py)(H2O)2](NO3)·10py. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 1 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 1 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
